lead.headline: Serious water-system defects found before 2022 are still unfixed in 19% of West Virginia cases, against 3% elsewhere
lead.number: Pre-2022 unfixed inspection-defect cases still open: West Virginia 19.0%, EPA-run tribal land in Region 9 11.3%, Louisiana 8.8%, other states 3.0%; open 2+ years: WV 218, LA 337, Region 9 48.
lead.watch_out: The physical thing is an unfixed inspection defect, not contaminated water, and Region 9 logs close-outs a median 478 days late.
